note: Gzip bytes. `initial-graph` is the entry chunk plus its static imports — what a first visit downloads before paint. The audit fails only ABOVE these numbers plus tolerance. Ratchet down by improving the split and re-running with --update-baseline; never re-record to admit a regression. WP 5.2j re-recorded `total-js` ALONE and deliberately left `initial-graph` where it was: the manual's eighty pages roughly doubled in depth and gained eleven generated fact modules, and every byte of that landed in the lazily-loaded DocPage chunk (194.9 kB to 202.0 kB gzip). The entry graph did not move — it is 156.6 kB with the growth and was 156.6 kB without it — so re-recording it too would have ratcheted UP the one number this gate exists to hold down, on growth that never touched it. If total-js is what is red on a future branch, check DocPage first: it is the only chunk this package made larger.
